newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Feed group buys 54,000T US corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Feed group buys 54,000T US corn at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn from Angre at a tender on Thursday, traders said.
In an unusual twist, the MFIG group granted an option to Angre to respecify the shipment before April 15.
Under the option, the quantity can range between 54,000 and 56,000 tonnes and the origin can be switched to Argentina, one of the group's buyers said.
The buyer said the group decided to offer more leeway for suppliers to operate because recent high volatility in recent U.S. corn futures had increased the risk of sourcing U.S. corn.
The shipment was bought on a cost-and-freight basis.
The group's main buyers are Formosa Oilseed, Fomau Cereal, Morn Sun Feed Mill and Shin Tai Industry.
